When the time was right, the abyss attacked, utilizing their newfound power to unleash havoc on the world. Their onslaught was put on hold when humanity banded together to create the "kanmusu" aka shipgirls, human women who undergo a process to utilize scaled down variants of naval equipment which grants much needed fire power against the abyssal ship girls. This inevitably lead for the abyss to form stronger units like So-Class, Tsu-Class, Re-Class, and even the installations like Harbour and Midway Princess.
